name: container-cold-start-probe
//: Throwaway DEPLOYED probe: real CF-side timings for the Nebula build-box sequence (cold container start → restore source → npm install → vite build → return dist). Local Docker cannot see CF instance acquisition; this can. Tear down with `npm run teardown` — `wrangler delete` alone leaves the container app running against the account quota.

scripts.teardown: wrangler delete --name container-cold-start-probe && wrangler containers delete container-cold-start-probe
